hardware.label: Viking 1 lander
hardware.provenance: NASA MODEL (NASA 3D Resources: Viking Lander), scaled so the footpad triangle is 2.21 m (NSSDCA). Orientation ILLUSTRATIVE (not sourced). The model has no separately named instruments, so inspection frames the whole lander.

origin.registration: Catalogue coordinate; the hardware has NOT been identified in the HiRISE orthoimage yet. Historical coordinate frames can differ from the HiRISE/MOLA-controlled frame by up to hundreds of metres, so the true spot may be elsewhere in this terrain or beyond it.

terrain.dtm: USGS Astrogeology controlled HiRISE DTM DTEEC_001521_2025_001719_2025_U01 (collection mro_hirise_socet_dtms)
terrain.albedo: HiRISE orthoimage (RED band, single channel) at 0.5 m, colourised with an ILLUSTRATIVE soil ramp
terrain.horizon: same DTM, decimated to ~24 m, out to ~9 km where the DTM covers it
